summary: CCSPv2 reports cover the previous month by default; override with `build_report --month=2025-03`, `--since/--until` dates, `--since=6months`, and `--force` to overwrite an existing report.
questions: How do I build a metrics-utility report for a specific month?
How do I overwrite an existing metrics-utility report?

answer_card.title: CCSPv2 report date ranges
answer_card.answer_md:
Default: previous month.
```bash
metrics-utility build_report --month=2025-03
metrics-utility build_report --since=2025-03-01 --until=2025-03-31
metrics-utility build_report --since=6months
metrics-utility build_report --since=6months --force   # overwrite existing
```
